summary: Bradford has built safety and crime as a central, recurring policy area, framing Toronto as having seen a "collapse in safety" and identifying it as a top concern of residents. Bradford supports increased police presence including officers at every TTC subway station, improved lighting and cleanliness on transit, and platform edge doors. Bradford supports clearing encampments within 200 metres of playgrounds, schools, and daycares within 48 hours of being reported, and has brought multiple council motions to that effect. Bradford champions "bubble zone" bylaws around places of worship, schools, and daycares, opposes antisemitic and Islamophobic incidents, and supports stronger enforcement against illegal jet ski rentals and reckless drivers. Bradford has pledged Bail Compliance Units within Toronto Police, opposed cuts to the police budget, and supported community-based youth violence prevention.

key_positions.stance: Supports placing police officers at every TTC subway station and improving lighting, cleanliness, and platform edge doors on transit
Supports clearing encampments within 200 metres of playgrounds, schools, and daycares within 48 hours of being reported, opposing Mayor Chow's encampment protocol
Supports bubble zone/safe access bylaws around places of worship, schools, and daycares, having advocated for them since 2024
Opposes antisemitism and hate-motivated attacks on Jewish institutions, businesses, and individuals; calls for prosecution as hate crimes
Supports stronger enforcement and regulation of motorized watercraft and jet ski rentals at Toronto beaches
Supports a 'no bail, go to jail' approach for gun offences and creating Toronto Police Bail Compliance Units
Opposes cuts to the police budget and supports fully funding police including hiring frontline officers
Supports investing in youth violence prevention programs in partnership with community-embedded organizations
Supports Vision Zero road safety measures including speed cameras, school safety zones, and traffic calming, while criticizing repeated speed camera vandalism
Supports a non-police response pilot for non-violent crisis calls and reform of policing roles
